scripts.postinstall: corepack pnpm --filter api exec prisma generate --schema=../../packages/database/schema.prisma
scripts.dev: concurrently "corepack pnpm --filter api dev" "corepack pnpm --filter public-portal dev"
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter api build && corepack pnpm --filter public-portal build
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter api test && corepack pnpm --filter public-portal test
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter api lint && corepack pnpm --filter public-portal lint
